relevance_note: Cross-sectional study of allergy-associated features in nine monogenic autoinflammatory diseases at the NIH; the HA20 patients appear only as a group ("HA20 (n=14)") in aggregate percentages and per-disease counts, with no identifiable individual (no label, sex, age or variant for any one person).
method_note: Read the whole Markdown by hand; no script transcription. HA20 patients appear only in cohort-level summaries: Table 1 (per-disease demographics and treatment percentages), Table 2 (urticaria percentages), and two count statements in the Results: 'eosinophilic gastroenteritis (EGE) was diagnosed in 2 patients (HA20 and HIDS)' and 'perioral swelling temporally associated with flare was reported by one family with TRAPS and one patient each with DADA2, HA20, and CANDLE'. These one-per-cohort counts give no label, sex, age or variant, and the paper does not say whether the HA20 EGE patient and the HA20 perioral-swelling patient are the same person, so they were treated as group-level counts and no individual rows were created (rule 5: do not create a person the document does not describe). No TNFAIP3 variant is printed anywhere; supplementary tables are listed only as titles with no content. Minor internal inconsistency: Table 1 gives 'Identified (total)' 14 for HA20, matching the text 'HA20 (n=14)', but the totals elsewhere differ by cohort (e.g. FMF n=118 in text vs 117 identified in Table 1); the enrolment protocol is given as '94-HG-0105' in Results but '94-HG-0104' in Methods. cites_prior_report_of_same_patients left null: the paper does not say whether any patient was described before.
